jobs.description:
Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Are you ready for a new challenge where your expertise can truly make a difference?

If you have a Scientific degree and experience in Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field, this is your opportunity to be part of something bigger than yourself. As an Operations Expert, you'll play a key role in manufacturing advanced cell therapies that are transforming cancer treatment and giving patients new hope.

Every day, your work will directly contribute to delivering life-changing therapies to patients facing serious diseases. Join a passionate team united by a shared purpose: creating innovative treatments and improving lives around the world.

Your key responsibilities:

• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste.

Who we are looking for:

• You have obtained at least a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
• Cell experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

Operator / Bender - Zwevegem   FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING
Do you have a passion for technology and are you looking for a challenging job with responsibility?Become a bending machine operator in an innovative production environment! You'll bend pipes of various sizes, cut them to length where needed, and remove burrs. The work can be physically demanding, especially with larger pipes. Experience in the metal industry is a strong plus.

What are you tasks?

• 
Operate and set up the bending machine to ensure precise pipe shaping.

• 
Monitor the process and intervene in case of malfunctions to guarantee a perfect end product.

• 
2-shift system!

Dutch and/or English language skills are required.
PROFIEL
Your profile:

• 
You have technical knowledge or experience in a similar role.

• 
Accuracy and attention to detail are your strong suits.

• 
You are eager to learn and interested in automation and production processes.

• 
You can work independently, but also thrive in a team environment.

• 
Safety and quality are always your top priorities.
AANBOD
Our offer:

• 
A stable job in an innovative production environment.

• 
Competitive salary with extra benefits – salary   12.50% shift bonus.

• 
Internal training and opportunities for growth.

• 
Work in a dynamic team with a positive and supportive atmosphere.
STUDIEVEREISTENGeen specifieke studievereisten
.

The company is a leading international player operating in a highly customer-centric and relationship-driven industry.In Belgium, it works closely with an extensive network of professional partners, providing innovative solutions, commercial support and expert guidance to help them grow their business.Backed by a strong culture of innovation and continuous improvement, the company is recognized for its commitment to customer excellence, people development and sustainable growth.

Jobomschrijving

The Account Manager - Optical Sector will have the following responsibilities :

• Drive commercial growth across Flanders by expanding the presence of ophthalmic solutions within targeted healthcare accounts.
• Identify, engage and develop new business opportunities with ophthalmologists, clinics and hospital-based eye care professionals.
• Strengthen partnerships with existing customers while building long-term relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers.
• Lead the development of strategic growth areas such as myopia management, leveraging clinical evidence and market insights.
• Promote innovative vision care solutions, including products addressing presbyopia and eye protection needs.
• Design and implement territory plans that translate market opportunities into sustainable business results.
• Act as a trusted advisor to customers by providing expertise on products, market trends, pricing and practice development opportunities.
• Coordinate cross-functional activities, including product implementation, customer training and ongoing support, to ensure a best-in-class customer experience.

• Optometrist
• Proven success in sales (MedTech / Eyecare is a must)
• Hunter profile
• Network in ophthalmology 
• Fluent in Dutch and English (French is a plus)

jobs.occupation: Head of Sales - Regulated B2B Services
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international service provider operating across multiple countries in Europe and beyond. With several hundred employees in Belgium and a strong position in its market, the company is currently entering a new phase of growth driven by innovation, strategic partnerships and evolving customer needs.To support this development, our client is looking for a Head of Sales Belgium.

Jobomschrijving

Reporting directly to the Managing Director and sitting on the local leadership team, you will lead the commercial function, shape the sales strategy, develop key customer relationships and manage a team of experienced sales professionals.Commercial Strategy & Growth

• Define and execute the commercial strategy for the Belgian market.
• Translate business objectives into clear action plans and measurable KPIs.
• Identify growth opportunities and drive business development initiatives.
• Monitor commercial performance, sales activity and pipeline development.
• Contribute to the overall business strategy as a member of the management team.
Team Leadership

• Lead, coach and develop a team of 3 sales professionals.
• Foster a high-performance culture focused on customer value and commercial results.
• Support the team in managing complex sales cycles and strategic accounts.
• Ensure effective collaboration across departments.
Key Account Management

• Build and maintain long-term relationships with major national customers.
• Manage executive-level conversations with key decision-makers.
• Lead commercial negotiations and contract discussions.
• Act as a trusted partner for strategic clients and stakeholders.
Marketing Coordination

• Coordinate local marketing initiatives in collaboration with international colleagues.
• Manage relationships with external marketing partners and agencies.
• Support brand visibility, customer engagement and commercial campaigns.
• Contribute to market positioning and business growth initiatives.

What matters most is your ability to lead teams, build commercial strategies and drive business results in a B2B environment.You bring:

• A proven track record in a B2B commercial leadership role.
• Experience managing and developing sales teams.
• Strong commercial acumen and strategic thinking skills.
• Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management capabilities.
• Experience working with large accounts and complex customer environments.
• The ability to build structure, set priorities and drive execution.
• A hands-on mindset combined with strong leadership qualities.
• Curiosity and the willingness to learn and understand a new industry.
• Fluency in Dutch, French, English

jobs.occupation: line leader slicing - meat company | oudenaarde | 2 shifts
jobs.description:
Line Leader Slicing - Meat Company | Oudenaarde | 2 ShiftsFUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING
For a growing food production company in Oudenaarde, we are looking for a Line Leader Slicing. The company specializes in slicing and packaging ham products for various supermarket chains.As a Line Leader, you will be responsible for the smooth operation of the slicing line. You will coordinate the production process, support and supervise operators, ensure product quality, and make sure all hygiene and safety standards are respected.

Your Responsibilities

• Leading and supporting employees on the slicing line.
• Setting up, monitoring, and adjusting production machines.
• Ensuring product quality and correct packaging.
• Solving minor machine issues and reporting technical problems.
• Monitoring compliance with hygiene, quality, and safety regulations.
• Following up on production targets and reporting results.
The job is not physically demanding!

Early shift: 5:00 a.m.–1:30 p.m.

Late shift: 1:30 p.m.–10:00 p.m.

You get a half-hour break.
PROFIEL
Profile

• Previous experience in a production environment is required, preferably within the food industry.
• Experience as a team leader, supervisor, or line leader is an advantage.
• You are detail-oriented and quality-focused.
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system.
• You have good communication and leadership skills.
• You will speak in English, Polish or Ukrainian with your colleaguesAANBOD
What do we offer you?

• We offer competitive and fair compensation, and there is no mandatory collective leave.
• You can schedule your time off as you wish.
• A quick start is possible.
• You’ll work on a weekly contract basis, and after a successful temporary assignment, you’ll be offered a permanent contract. STUDIEVEREISTENGeen specifieke studievereisten

Line Supervisor | 2 ShiftsFUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING
Are you an experienced operator who is ready to take the next step in your career?Do you already have some initial experience in leadership and are you able to motivate and guide a team of employees?

Job Description:

• You are responsible for the production line assigned to you.
• Your team consists of about 9 employees (both permanent and temporary staff).
• You motivate your entire team and ensure a positive atmosphere and strong cooperation.
• You also actively take part in the production process, monitoring and controlling it.
• You stay alert and suggest improvements.
• You are able to solve small technical issues.
• During shift changes, you are responsible for the handover.

PROFIEL
• You have experience leading a team.
• You have strong social and communication skills, allowing you to communicate effectively (also with technicians and other departments).
• Working with people of different nationalities does not intimidate you.
• You can express yourself well in English. Basic knowledge of Bulgarian or Polish is a plus.
• Your formal education is less important, but you have a strong motivation to keep learning.
• You are mature, flexible, stress-resistant, and able to work independently.
• You take responsibility for your work.
• You report to the Production Manager.

AANBOD
What do you get?

• A varied and responsible position where you get the opportunity to further develop your leadership skills.
• Work in a dynamic environment, where no two days are the same and you are constantly challenged to optimize processes and lead a motivated team.
• A commuting allowance, so you can travel to and from work comfortably and cost-effectively.STUDIEVEREISTENGeen specifieke studievereisten

As Project Lead, you will be responsible for setting up and implementing a new HR Shared Service Centre. Working closely with HR and business stakeholders, you will drive process improvements, manage transitions, and ensure an efficient and compliant HR service delivery model.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and implement the HR Shared Service operating model, including services, governance, and team structure.

• Standardize HR processes across countries and support the implementation of HR technology and self-service tools.

• Ensure compliance with labor laws, data privacy regulations, and local legal requirements.

• Lead the migration of HR processes into the Shared Service Centre, including documentation, training, and go-live activities.

• Act as the main point of contact for HR leaders, project sponsors, and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Manage project plans, timelines, risks, and status reporting.

• Drive change management, communication, and training initiatives to support successful adoption.

• Establish performance metrics, SLA monitoring, and continuous improvement programs to enhance service quality.

 

We are looking for an experienced HR transformation professional who can lead the design and implementation of a new HR Shared Service Centre in an international environment.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, or a related field; MBA or postgraduate qualification is a plus.

• 6-10 years of experience in HR consulting, HR Shared Services, HR outsourcing (HRO/BPO), or HR transformation projects.

• At least 2-3 years of hands-on experience in designing and implementing HR Shared Service Centres.

• Proven track record of leading large-scale, international HR transformation or shared services projects.

• Strong stakeholder management and project leadership skills.

• Excellent communication skills and fluent English.

Performing fine welding work (semi-automatic)

Filing, grinding, and assembling components
